cases.behavior: 用户报告修复必须映射到持久化 badcase，CI 拒绝遗漏映射、历史缩减及跳过或错文件的伪通过。

requiredNames: continuous badcase registration requires each reported behavior to map to a registered case from the same source
continuous badcase registration prevents removal, source loss, assertion shrinkage and unsupported exclusion against base
continuous badcase registration registered behavior must really pass in its declared file, never skip or pass elsewhere
continuous badcase registration does not mask a skipped exact assertion with a passing duplicate or longer name
continuous badcase registration allows first incremental registry introduction but never treats an unreadable base as empty

cases.reproduction: PR 声明已修复用户报告，但没有登记对应 case；或从既有清单删除映射后运行回归。
cases.expected: 缺少同来源映射或缩减基线时登记守卫失败；登记的测试必须在指定文件实际通过。
cases.forbidden: 空声明、错误文件同名测试、skip 或 excluded 被当作已修复证据。
cases.rootCause: 原入口只校验历史快照，没有持续 PR 修复登记与比较基线约束。
